text.description_html:
Acorn AI2BQ, Spear Tip Cabinet Strap Smooth Iron Hinge

The 9" Smooth Iron Strap Hinge is suitable for lightweight door or cabinets. These are specially designed for use on batten or tongue and grooved doors. The old world charm is in both the spear tip design and in the smooth iron finish which is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago. The Smooth Iron Cabinet Spear Tip Strap Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty.

When combined with our other great Hand Forged Iron Products, Acorn can really make your home stand out.

Features for the 9" Spear Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • For doors whose face sits flush with the door frame.
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications for the Acorn Spear Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 9"
  • Width: 1-3/4"

Sold as a pair (2-hinges).
